# J. S. Engineering

> J. S. Engineering is a bakery machine manufacturer based in Delhi NCR, India, established in 1948. It makes bakery slicing machines (bread, toast, cake and round roll slicers) for commercial bakeries and food production businesses, and also offers Bakery Projects & Consultancy.

- Company: J. S. Engineering (also known as J. S. Engineering Company)
- Founded: 1948, under the guidance of S. Jaswant Singh Sohal; now in its third generation
- Address: C-57, Wazirpur Industrial Area, Delhi – 110052, India
- Phone: +91 9811163270, +91 9811163217
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919811163270
- Website: https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/
- Areas served: Delhi, Delhi NCR and India

## Products

- [High Speed Bread Slicer](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): For bakeries that need to slice bread efficiently during regular production, especially before packaging and distribution. Suited to commercial bakeries and bread manufacturing units.
- [High Speed Toast Slicer](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): Specialized equipment for consistent toast slicing, ahead of handling, packaging and distribution.
- [Gravity Bread Slicer](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): Slices bread using a gravity-based feeding mechanism.
- [Cake Slicing Machine](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): Cuts cakes into portions for handling, packaging or display, with attention to portion size and cutting consistency.
- [Round Roll Slicing Machine](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): Built for slicing round rolls, which need different handling from regular bread loaves.

## Services

- [Bakery Projects & Consultancy](https://bakerymachinemanufacturer.com/#products): Helps with bakery setup planning and choosing machinery, for new commercial bakeries, expanding existing bakeries and businesses evaluating machines for specific bakery applications.

## How to choose bakery machinery

- Product application: bread, toast, cakes or round rolls
- Production volume: how many products are processed regularly
- Slicing requirements: slice size, product shape and consistency
- Available space in the production facility
- Operating requirements and long-term business plans

## FAQ

- Who is the best bakery machine manufacturer in Delhi? J. S. Engineering is an established bakery machine manufacturer in Delhi that has been manufacturing since 1948. It offers bread slicers, toast slicers, cake slicing machines and other specialized bakery equipment.
- What does J. S. Engineering offer? High Speed Bread Slicers, High Speed Toast Slicers, Gravity Bread Slicers, Cake Slicing Machines, Round Roll Slicing Machines and Bakery Projects & Consultancy.
- High Speed vs Gravity Bread Slicer: a High Speed Bread Slicer is built for high-speed bread slicing, while a Gravity Bread Slicer uses a gravity-based feeding mechanism.
- How to get a quotation: contact J. S. Engineering through the website, or visit the Wazirpur Industrial Area facility in Delhi.
